title: fagara syncarpa
intro: Fagara syncarpa, commonly known as the Chinese prickly ash, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rutaceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, sore throat, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Fagara syncarpa include stimulating the circulation, relieving pain and spasms, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
